movement_source: row 'Common Equity Tier 1 (APRA Level 2) ratio', column 30 Jun 20 column -> column 30 Jun 21 column
headline: CBA's APRA Level 2 (Group) CET1 ratio rose 150 bpts in FY21, from 11.6% at 30 June 2020 to 13.1% at 30 June 2021 (ev-12, ev-13, ev-17, ev-19). The full-year walk (presentation p111, sum check passed) attributes the +150 bpts to: Divestments +42, APRA Operational Risk add-on reduction +17, 2H20 dividend -32, Cash NPAT +88, Underlying RWA -13, Other -2 (1H21); then 1H21 dividend -59, Cash NPAT +97, RWA +8, Other +4 (2H21). The bank's own half-on-half narrative for the 6 months to Jun 21 states capital generated from earnings +97 bpts, lower total RWA +8 bpts, other regulatory adjustments +4 bpts, partly offset by the 2021 interim dividend -59 bpts (ev-14). CET1 remained above APRA's 'unquestionably strong' 10.5% benchmark throughout FY21 (ev-18).

drivers.narrative: Divestments added +42 bpts to the CET1 ratio in the full-year walk. The bank states total divestment capital uplift of $7.9bn since 1H19, of which $6.2bn was in excess of the unquestionably strong benchmark (ev-20). Proceeds from BoCommLife, CommInsure Life and other divestments supported CET1 during the year (ev-22).

APRA's 20 November 2020 announcement reduced CBA's operational RWA add-on by 50%, from $12.5bn to $6.25bn, adding +17 bpts to CET1 (ev-8). The profit announcement confirms the Operational Risk RWA includes a $6.25bn add-on following the 50% reduction (ev-24).
The 2020 final dividend reduced CET1 by -32 bpts; the DRP was satisfied by the issuance of shares, limiting the cash drag (ev-9).

Capital generated from earnings in the half ended Dec 20 added +88 bpts to CET1. The bank describes profits generated in the ordinary course of business (organic capital) as supporting CET1 during the year (ev-22).
Underlying RWA movement in the half ended Dec 20 reduced CET1 by -13 bpts. The bank does not separately decompose this first-half RWA bar in the FY21 documents reviewed.
Other regulatory adjustments in the half ended Dec 20 reduced CET1 by -2 bpts. The bank does not separately itemise this first-half 'Other' bar.

The 2021 interim dividend reduced CET1 by -59 bpts; the DRP was satisfied in full by the on-market purchase of shares (ev-10). The profit announcement confirms the on-market purchase of $418m of shares (CET1 impact of 9 bpts) in respect of the DRP (ev-15).
Capital generated from earnings in the 6 months ended 30 June 2021 added +97 bpts, excluding net equity accounted profits from associates (ev-14). This matches the bank's stated half-on-half driver.

Lower total RWA in the 6 months ended 30 June 2021 added +8 bpts (ev-14). Total RWA fell $2.9bn or 1% on the prior half to $450.7bn, driven by reductions in Operational, Traded Market and IRRBB RWA, partly offset by higher Credit RWA (ev-23).
Other regulatory adjustments in the 6 months ended 30 June 2021 added +4 bpts (ev-14), including the receipt of final proceeds from the sale of CommInsure Life (+2 bpts) (ev-11, ev-16).

notable_items: Off-market share buy-back of $6bn announced (pro-forma -133 bpts, not part of the FY21 walk)
Expected future CET1 uplift of 30-40 bpts from Colonial First State and 9 bpts from CommInsure General Insurance divestments (subject to regulatory approvals)

disagreements.explanation: The internationally comparable CET1 ratio is a different measure from the APRA Level 2 (Group) CET1 ratio; it moved +200 bpts (17.4% to 19.4%) vs the +150 bpts on the APRA basis.
The Level 1 CET1 ratio is a different measure from the Level 2 (Group) ratio; it is quoted as context only.

limitations: The full-year CET1 walk is published only in the results presentation (p111); the profit announcement's narrative (p53) describes only the half-on-half (6 months to Jun 21) drivers, which match the second half of the walk. The first-half bars (Divestments +42, APRA add-on reduction +17, 2H20 Div -32, Cash NPAT +88, Underlying RWA -13, Other -2) are corroborated only by the walk chart and the bank's qualitative statements, not by a separate full-year narrative.
The 'Underlying RWA' (-13) and 'Other' (-2) first-half bars are not separately decomposed by the bank in the FY21 documents reviewed; their narratives rely on the walk chart alone.

The off-market share buy-back (-133 bpts) and expected Colonial First State / CommInsure General Insurance divestment uplifts are pro-forma items outside the FY21 comparison window and are not part of the FY21 walk.

The Group's CET1 ratio (APRA) was 13.1% as at 30 June 2021, an increase of 50 basis points from 31 December 2020 and an increase of 150 basis points from 30 June 2020.

Key drivers of the change in CET1 for the 6 months ended 30 June 2021 were capital generated from earnings (+97 basis points, excluding net equity accounted profits from associates), lower total RWA (+8 basis points) and other regulatory adjustments (+4 basis points), partly offset by the 2021 interim dividend (-59 basis points) in which the DRP was satisfied in full by the on-market purchase of shares.
